## Legs: run vs queued

### Engineering legs — RAN (offline only)

- `db/src/db/technology_backfill.py` — the committed
  dry-run-by-default backfill (691 lines; the P34.21a rights-backfill
  split mirrored: the db package owns the write path, free of
  connector concepts):
  - `plan_backfill(conn, declared, licenses)` — enumerates every
    `traffic_camera:*` subject key in `entity_identity_key`
    (`sig.connector.subject` scheme, LIKE-prefix scan, deterministic
    `ORDER BY value`), parses `(source, target, ref)` out of the key
    itself — malformed keys are counted and skipped, never
    force-matched — and looks the pair up in the same
    `declared_technologies()` map the emit path reads. A subject
    whose target declares nothing lands in `skipped.undeclared`
    (counted per target in the report; no guessed slug — the
    NEW-7/FM-05 defect this family replaced is substring inference).
  - Existing `technology` claims are read back per subject:
    subjects already typed by THIS connector
    (`ingest_run.connector_name = 'technology-backfill'`) get their
    evidence links topped up so an interrupted run's partial link
    pass completes on re-run; subjects typed by ANOTHER connector
    (the P35.15a emit path already ran over them) are counted
    `already_typed.other` and left untouched — the backfill never
    asserts ownership over another run's claims.
  - Evidence resolution: the subject's existing
    `claim → claim_evidence → evidence_capture → evidence_artifact`
    chains are read; the plan picks the latest *bindable* actual
    capture (valid multihash `content_digest` — `decode_multihash`
    verifies — `capture_classification='actual'`, artifact
    `source_id` agreeing with the subject's source) as the sink
    binding, and plans supplementary `corroborates` links to the
    subject's other existing captures. A subject with no bindable
    capture gains nothing and is reported `skipped.no_evidence` —
    **no claim is written without an evidence link, and no
    synthetic provenance is minted**. Merged-identity cases
    (multiple keys → one entity) are counted
    `aliased_entity_keys`, never silently dropped.
  - `apply_plan(...)` — stages each pending claim through
    `PgClaimSink.assert_claims` (the real `sig.assertion/1`
    adapter: closed-vocabulary gate, `content_digest` claim
    identity, chunked `conn.transaction()` commits, `ON CONFLICT
    DO NOTHING`). The sink runs `is_replay` so the links classify
    `replayed` honestly (ADR-113). Claims are labelled
    backfill-derived three ways — `assertion_rationale` names the
    ticket/findings, `derived_from_claim_ids` cites the subject's
    existing `traffic_camera` registry claims, the run writes
    `connector_name='technology-backfill'` +
    `extraction.method='declared_technology_backfill'` — never
    connector-fresh. The supplementary `claim_evidence` pass is a
    plain `INSERT … ON CONFLICT (claim_id, capture_id, role) DO
    NOTHING` in `LINK_BATCH_SIZE` batches, chunked by commit.
    `record_completion()` appends the `ingest_run_completion`
    row. A clean re-run appends +0; the report exposes
    `claims_added`, per-target/per-slug counts and the registered
    vocabulary probe (`_registration` refuses the apply when the
    `technology` predicate / `camera_registry` genre are absent —
    the hosted-registration precondition checked, not assumed).
  - INSERT-only throughout: the module contains no `UPDATE` or
    `DELETE` statement; every write is conflict-safe.
- `connectors/src/connectors/cli.py` — `sig-connectors
  technology-backfill --dsn … [--apply] [--commit-chunk-size N]
  [--code-commit <sha>]`: reads `target_table()` +
  `declared_technologies()` from the committed registry (the same
  source the emitter reads — the two can never disagree), runs
  `target_technology_violations()` fail-closed BEFORE any DSN is
  touched (a registry defect exits 1, same rule
  `sig-connectors validate` already enforces), resolves the
  P26.18 commit-chunk-size path and the registry rights resolver
  (`sinks._registry_rights`), and prints the JSON report.
- `tests/unit/test_technology_backfill_helpers.py` (11 tests) —
  subject-key parsing (malformed, escaped), deterministic target
  ordering, declared-slug selection, undeclared-subject skipping,
  duplicate/idempotent planning, no-evidence reporting.
- `tests/db/test_technology_backfill.py` (450 lines, Docker-gated
  real-PG suite — skips honestly without the daemon, fails loud
  under `SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS`) — seeded pre-PKG-07 spine: a
  Flock-lineage subject gains its declared ALPR-family claim with
  `claim_evidence` links to its existing captures; a second
  `--apply` reads `claims_added=0` (+0-convergent, resumable);
  undeclared targets untouched; already-typed subjects untouched;
  zero claims without evidence links; the plan's counts match the
  apply's; `n_tup_upd`/`n_tup_del` on the touched tables stay 0.

## Deviations

- **Test-file rename pre-commit** — `tests/unit/test_technology_
  backfill.py` renamed to `test_technology_backfill_helpers.py`
  during `make check`: pytest's module-name collision with
  `tests/db/test_technology_backfill.py` (same basename) broke
  collection; the rename makes the pure-helper scope explicit.
- **Docker unreachable** — `tests/db` + `tests/e2e` skipped
  locally; CI's `composed`/`python` legs carry the real-PG suite
  on the head-bound run (recorded, not claimed).
- **`SIG_GCP_PROJECT` armed locally** — the P34.2 fail-closed
  leak check ran armed and passed; no sentinel deviation.
- **Evidence links ride existing captures only** — the plan's
  bindable-capture contract (valid multihash + `actual`
  classification + artifact `source_id` agreeing with the
  subject's source) is stricter than "any capture": a subject
  whose only evidence fails the contract is reported
  `no_evidence`, never given a fabricated provenance row. The
  supplementary link pass is a plain-column `claim_evidence`
  INSERT (the typed-binding path writes the bound capture's
  `establishes` row itself) — recorded so a reader knows the two
  link shapes are deliberate, not drift.
- **PR body committed post-push** — `docs/build/pr/P35.15b.md`
  landed `3490c4fd` after the impl head `1815e3b0` (the P35.15a
  `67bf1882` precedent); the sha-bound `ci:` line reads the
  post-body head.
